{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter: only completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter: exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
valid_df = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute average revenue per order by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = valid_df.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = valid_df.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rate_by_channel = valid_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Output all metrics
print('Average revenue per completed order by channel:')
print(avg_revenue_by_channel)
print('\nTotal revenue by channel:')
print(total_revenue_by_channel)
print('\nConversion rate by channel:')
print(conversion_rate_by_channel)"}
